blocks.p: An oven or a microwave shows its own controls in the *Crafting* tab of the *World* window, as in Figure 22-1.

caption: Figure 22-1
An oven in the Crafting tab.

blocks.p: Above the panel are the name of the appliance, its size in tiles and whether it is on. Under the panel, a line gives the state and the heat set, here *Off* and *Set 390°F*; under that is a list of what is in the oven.
To give the controls a window of their own, click the button in the corner of the panel. While they are out, the *Crafting* tab shows *Bring it back*; click it to return them to the tab.

marks.text: A button in the plate's corner pops the controls out into their own window.

blocks.h2: In a Window of Their Own

blocks.p: Figure 22-2 shows the controls of the oven in their own window, with the oven on and set to bake at 570°F, and the window of a microwave. A microwave has a face of its own, with its power level, time cook, number keys and start.

caption: Figure 22-2
An oven, top, and a microwave.

marks.text: The same controls work in the window. The line at its foot shows on or off, and the heat.
The microwave has its own face: power level, time cook, number keys and start.

sticky.text: In the tab, or in their own window.
